mission: The Speakers and Stage committee strives to contribute to the DUU overall mission through large event programming. Our programming consists of contracting a wide range of speakers that is representative of the student body's interests and current events. We are working to organize types of events (keynotes, panelists, small speakers) according to the needs of the campus. The most important goal of the committee is selecting and organizing events reflective of the collective student voice at Duke.

duu.heading: Part of Duke University Union
text: Duke University Union (DUU) is Duke’s largest student organization and its student-led hub for events, programming, arts, and media.

Through 18 committees, DUU produces more than 200 events and media projects each year—from weekly Jazz@ the Mary Lou and Duke Student Broadcasting collaborations with Duke Basketball to the LDOC concert.
Our mission is simple: to provide diverse, community-centered, and creative programming and media that support Duke’s social, educational, and professional goals.

stats.label: Events and media projects each year

whatWeDo: Speakers & Stage seeks to present high quality speaker events across all topics, styles, and genres. These topics have included comedy, sports, and activism, while previous speakers have included Cody Ko, Pete Davidson, Sue Bird, and Nikki Glaser. The committee is open to all students. Members of the committee work on selecting speakers, event planning, marketing, and can possibly even host an event!
